integrity: The result follows from the norming-functional characterization, an explicit size-biased moment compression for p>2, and the bijective normalized duality maps for 1<p<2. Every endpoint and equality configuration is addressed in the analytic proof. The bundled exact-symbolic and sampled checks supplement the proof; no independent audit or external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only real scalar Lp spaces on sigma-finite measure spaces of dimension at least two, with 1<p<infinity. The optimal constant is generally specified by a one-variable maximum rather than an elementary closed form, and the theorem does not treat stability or vector-valued Lp spaces.
title: Dimension-free \(C\)-approximate Birkhoff symmetry of real \(L_p\) spaces
